summary: Agent found list.js, hit an internal "Interlock" ladder check on its first Edit attempt, reasoned it was rung 2, retried, and changed PAGE_SIZE 10 → 25 without asking the user anything or invoking brainstorming.
reasoning: The requested change landed on disk with no design discussion, no clarifying question, no permission request, and no brainstorming skill load. Both acceptance criteria are satisfied per the session log and the file contents.

observations.description: The agent's first Edit call was rejected by an internal tooling message ("Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap...") rendered in red as an Error on screen. It resolved itself on retry, but a red Error block for expected, benign flow is confusing to a user watching the transcript.
Internal framework jargon leaks into the user-visible transcript: "Ladder check: ... Rung 2, proceeding." A developer who just asked for a constant bump has no idea what a rung is.
One duplicate Edit tool call (identical old/new strings) was made due to the interlock retry — minor wasted work, ~18s total turn.

criteria.criterion: Agent made the edit directly as one local edit
criteria.evidence: coding-agent-workdir/list.js line 1: `const PAGE_SIZE = 25;`; session log tool_use: {"name":"Edit",..."old_string":"const PAGE_SIZE = 10;","new_string":"const PAGE_SIZE = 25;"}; screen: "PAGE_SIZE in list.js:1 is now 25. No other changes." Only tools used were Bash(find), Read, Edit (x2, first blocked by interlock).

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised to the user
criteria.evidence: jq over the session log for assistant tool_use returned only Bash/Read/Edit — no Skill call (`jq -c 'select(.type=="assistant")|.message.content[]|select(.type=="tool_use")|{name,input}'`). Grep for 'brainstorming' matched only system-prompt/skill-instruction text, not an invocation. Screen shows no question to the user; the only assistant prose before the edit was "Ladder check: no security, data-loss, removal, or interface change ... Rung 2, proceeding." and then the edit.
